metadata_details.description:
A chilling psychological horror set in 1980s Kerala. After weeks of silence, you arrive on a remote island to search for your missing wife. Explore an abandoned house, uncover local folklore, survive haunting encounters, and unravel the island’s buried secrets.

Thekku Island is a story-driven, first-person horror game set on a fictional island in 1980s Kerala, India.

You arrive on a remote island after weeks of silence from your wife — she vanished without a trace. As you search the abandoned house and the dark forests around it, you're pulled deeper into a chilling mystery that refuses to stay buried.

As night falls, eerie whispers and unsettling noises echo through the halls. Shadows seem to move on their own, creeping across the walls as if alive. The deeper you go, the more you realize — something is terribly wrong.

Inspired by Indian ghost stories, Thekku Island blends psychological horror, classic ghost encounters, and jumpscare tension into an atmospheric experience where every clue deepens the mystery. There are no easy answers — only whispers from the past.

metadata_details.description:
Heatwave 是一部持续连载的剧情向视觉小说系列，讲述Sam 的人生故事。本作将聚焦于他那个夏天开始前的序章，而更多精彩的冒险，才刚刚开始！

在大学前的最后一个夏天，Sam 最没想到的是自己会住在Michael 家里——那是妈妈的前夫，一个他十多年没见过、而且印象并不好的男人。本来只是短暂的借住，却很快变得复杂起来：旧日的怨气与突如其来的好奇心碰撞在一起。

Sam 结识新朋友，面对陌生的念头，心中逐渐明朗：这次旅行不只是熬过去，而是去发现自己真正渴望的东西。

In this point-and-click urban thriller, down-and-out private eye Kathy Rain will embark on her most dangerous case yet — the pursuit of the notorious serial killer known as the Soothsayer. Find clues, gather evidence, connect the dots, and confront the murderer before the hunter becomes the hunted…
